extraction_warnings.message: EDGAR provided only two annual 10-Ks because Rubrik is a recent IPO; the historical_annuals recommendation of three filings is not fully met. The FY2026 10-K itself contains three-year comparative financial statements.
The automatically fetched proxy document is DEFA14A supplemental material rather than the full definitive DEF 14A. Governance/compensation analysis should obtain the definitive proxy if needed.
FY2025 stock-based compensation includes large cumulative RSU expense recognized around the IPO and should not be treated as a steady-state run rate without downstream normalization.
Partner A-D concentration is channel-partner concentration, not necessarily ultimate end-customer concentration.
